title: Require Domain Entrypoint Shape
forbids: domain root entrypoints outside the closed defineDomain contract, identity, import, and owner-slot re-export shape
why: A domain root owns one public domain contract identity. It binds the exact operation-contract registry once and may expose only named model or artifact owner slots; implementation modules and competing runtime authorities remain behind their dedicated boundaries.
remediate: Import defineDomain from Core contracts and ops from ./ops/contracts.js, bind one const domain with the directory id, default-export it, and keep any named re-exports within ./model/** or ./artifacts/index.js.
message: Domain index.ts must expose one directory-identified defineDomain authority plus only admitted model or artifact owner-slot re-exports.
